chars.YOUNG: YOUNG: a slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with white drawstrings, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.FATHER: FATHER: an older man wearing a brown wool djellaba with the hood down and a white knitted skullcap, small grey moustache drawn on the white head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small modest bedroom in a Moroccan town (Sidi Kacem). YOUNG sits at a cheap desk staring at an old laptop, slumped shoulders, disappointed face, one hand on his cheek. The laptop screen glows blue with a simple chart (no readable text). Face clearly visible, centred.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same bedroom at night, YOUNG leans forward and clicks the laptop mouse with determination, frowning, a cup of mint tea next to him, a small lamp. Centred, face visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: YOUNG lies in a narrow bed under a striped Moroccan blanket in a dark room, eyes open, worried, holding his phone on his chest, moonlight through a small window. Centred, face visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Morning sunlight in the same small bedroom. YOUNG in the mustard hoodie sits up in front of the laptop, eyes wide and mouth open in shock, both hands on his head. Centred, face visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YOUNG jumps with joy in the middle of the small bedroom, both arms raised high, huge smile, the laptop on the desk behind him, morning light. Full body centred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YOUNG sits proudly on the floor of his room surrounded by small stacks of printed paperback books with a plain dark cover (no text), holding one book up with a big smile. Centred, face visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A simple Moroccan living room with low sedari benches and patterned cushions. YOUNG hands a folded stack of banknotes to FATHER who is seated; FATHER looks surprised and touched, YOUNG smiles shyly. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YOUNG sits at a new desktop computer with a big monitor in his tidy room, typing happily, relaxed smile, a notebook and tea glass beside him, warm evening light. Centred, face visible.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: YOUNG stands in his room holding his paperback book (plain cover, no text) against his chest, looking straight at the viewer with a curious questioning expression, one eyebrow raised, the computer behind him. Centred, face visible.
